## Data & ML engineering

**[tidypredict — XGBoost → SQL](https://tidymodels.github.io/tidypredict/articles/xgboost.html)**
: Contributed the translation of XGBoost models into SQL, so trained models can be scored inside the database without an R or Python runtime.

**[treesnip](https://github.com/curso-r/treesnip)**
: LightGBM and CatBoost engines for the tidymodels framework.

**[embed — `step_woe()`](https://tidymodels.github.io/embed/reference/step_woe.html)**
: Contributed a weight-of-evidence preprocessing step, used in credit-risk feature engineering.

## AI tooling

**[targetfy](https://github.com/Athospd/targetfy)**
: A Claude Code skill that converts existing R scripts into an equivalent [{targets}](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/) pipeline. It never edits your scripts: it writes the pipeline next to them, runs both versions in throwaway copies and accepts the conversion only when their results match. It can then add dynamic branching, storage formats and parallel workers.

## Data ingestion & APIs

**[wikiaves](https://github.com/athospd/wikiaves)**
: R client for the WikiAves API — collects bird observation data and audio metadata.

**[wavesurfer](https://github.com/athospd/wavesurfer)**
: R/Shiny interface to wavesurfer.js for audio visualisation and labelling.

## Research

**[mestrado — acoustic bird detection](https://athospd.github.io/mestrado/)**
: M.Sc. project (Polytechnic School, University of São Paulo) on automatic detection of nocturnal bird species from field recordings. An R package that reproduces the pipeline: collecting recordings (xeno-canto, WikiAves), slicing and labelling audio, train/test splits, and a 1D convolutional network on raw audio.

## Deep learning

**[torchaudio](https://github.com/curso-r/torchaudio)**
: Audio deep-learning tools for R.

**[facenet](https://github.com/curso-r/facenet)**
: Face-recognition implementation with Torch.

**[torchdatasets](https://mlverse.github.io/torchdatasets/)**
: Contributed a dataset to the R torch datasets package.
